stories.t: GitHub and ScreenConnect cyberattacks
stories.x: On 12 Nov 2026, Cybersecurity News reported that a threat actor used stolen GitHub credentials to push a secret-stealing payload into tens of thousands of code repositories. On 12 Nov 2026, The Hacker News reported that an attacker used stolen credentials for 4,837 GitHub accounts to plant a secret stealer in repositories those accounts could write to.

stories.t: AntiFox AI penetration testing platform attacks
stories.x: On 11 Nov 2026, Security Affairs reported that Arctic Wolf saw attackers use the AntiFox pentest platform to hit IIS servers and AWS accounts. On 11 Nov 2026, The Hacker News reported that researchers disclosed details of a campaign in which an emerging agentic penetration testing platform called AntiFox has been used to steal AWS production secrets.

stories.t: Apache HTTP/2 and Palo Alto vulnerabilities
stories.x: On 12 Nov 2026, Cybersecurity News reported that Palo Alto Networks disclosed a remote code execution vulnerability in PAN-OS software running on Panorama, tracked as CVE-2026-0330. On 12 Nov 2026, Cybersecurity News reported that Apache fixed a critical bug in its HTTP/2 module, tracked as CVE-2026-119618, that could let a remote attacker run code on a web server.

stories.t: Maersk and Baker Tilly data breaches
stories.x: On 11 Nov 2026, BleepingComputer reported that the Baker Tilly Advisory Group is notifying clients of a data breach compromising personal information. On 11 Nov 2026, Security Affairs reported that Maersk confirmed a data breach involving a legacy system, while WhiteArmor claimed 100GB of stolen data and demanded a $5 million ransom.

stories.t: N-able takes N-central offline following zero-day disclosures
stories.x: On 11 Nov 2026, Dark Reading reported that N-able took its N-central platform offline after the discovery of 33 flaws and released a hotfix. On 11 Nov 2026, Infosecurity Magazine reported that N-able fixed seven N-central CVEs after 33 alleged zero-days were published.

stories.t: Vanderbilt University ransomware attack
stories.x: On 11 Nov 2026, Malwarebytes Labs reported that Vanderbilt University is restoring campus technology but has not confirmed attackers' claims of stolen student and employee data.

stories.t: Asian airline and bank supplier data breaches
stories.x: According to teiss, Finnair is the seventh airline hit by an Amadeus data breach that exposed more than 100,000 bookings. FTN news reported that a Thai Airways data breach exposed 60,529 flight bookings.

stories.t: N-able takes N-central offline following zero-day disclosures
stories.x: Cybersecurity News reported that N-able released an emergency hotfix for N-central following the public disclosure of 33 vulnerabilities. BleepingComputer reported that N-able released hotfixes to address zero-day bugs affecting its N-central remote monitoring and management platform.

stories.t: Railway AI customer keys breach
stories.x: The Hacker News reported that AI provider keys stored by customers on Railway were stolen in an October breach and used to commit an estimated $740,000 in unauthorized spending. BleepingComputer reported that cloud hosting provider Railway stated hackers exploited infrastructure vulnerabilities to steal customer authentication secrets and generate fraudulent charges.

stories.t: France blames Iran for refrigeration sabotage attacks
stories.x: Graham Cluley reported that France officially accused Iran of responsibility for cyberattacks last month that meddled with supermarket freezers and caused some to catch fire.

stories.t: Russian Turla group targets government Exchange servers
stories.x: ESET WeLiveSecurity reported on the Turla group's Cereal toolset, which features an Exchange email collection module, a command and control mechanism, and.NET execution techniques.

stories.t: Vanderbilt University ransomware attack
stories.x: CyberScoop reported that services began returning online following a ransomware incident detected across Vanderbilt systems and applications.

stories.t: Qubole supply chain attack compromises customer data
stories.x: BleepingComputer reported that a threat actor used compromised IAM credentials for a Qubole big data platform AWS account to access and exfiltrate data from multiple cloud environments.

stories.t: France blames Iran for refrigeration sabotage attacks
stories.x: Infosecurity Magazine reported that French authorities tied the cyberattack targeting supermarket fridges to Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and requested international arrest warrants. The Hacker News reported that an October cyberattack on refrigeration controllers at about 700 French retail sites was carried out by a cyber unit of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

stories.t: Russian Turla group targets government Exchange servers
stories.x: Help Net Security reported that the Russia-aligned group Turla planted a modular.NET toolset on Microsoft Exchange servers at two government organizations, one in Kazakhstan and one in Romania. Infosecurity Magazine reported that Turla used compromised Exchange servers to collect NATO and EU-linked emails.

stories.t: Vanderbilt University ransomware attack
stories.x: The Register Security reported that the BYOD ransomware group claimed extensive data theft as campus Wi-Fi returned at Vanderbilt University. Infosecurity Magazine reported that Vanderbilt University took its systems offline after the BYOD ransomware group claimed to have locked databases and stolen sensitive data.

stories.t: Google patches actively exploited Chrome zero-day vulnerability
stories.x: Security Affairs reported that Google patched nine Chrome flaws, including a V8 vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-125350, under active exploitation. BleepingComputer reported that Google released emergency security updates to patch a new Chrome vulnerability exploited in zero-day attacks, representing the eighth such flaw this year.

stories.t: Default Admin Password Let Researchers Unlock and Start Cars
stories.x: Infosecurity Magazine reported that default admin passwords on automaker login servers let researchers unlock and start test cars. The Register Security reported that a pair of researchers chained WAF bypasses and default logins to command vehicles in Australia and the US.

stories.t: N-able takes N-central offline following zero-day disclosures
stories.x: SecurityWeek reported that N-able took N-central offline as a researcher dropped over 30 zero-days enabling remote code execution and credential theft. The Hacker News reported that N-able took N-central Hosted Environments offline and urged on-premises customers to shut down servers after a researcher disclosed 33 zero-days with PoC exploits.

stories.t: OpenSSH SSHole vulnerability
stories.x: Cybersecurity News reported that CISA has flagged active exploitation of SSHole, an OpenSSH authentication bypass tracked as CVE-2026-123158 that lets remote attackers access certain Linux accounts. Schneier on Security reported that a newly disclosed flaw involving OpenSSH and musl, dubbed SSHole, allows attackers to log in.

stories.t: Qubole supply chain attack compromises customer data
stories.x: SecurityWeek reported that hackers used compromised Qubole IAM credentials to steal customer files, secrets, keys, environment variables, and credentials across over a dozen organizations. The Hacker News reported that an attacker broke into AWS accounts belonging to multiple Qubole customers between October 14 and October 26 and stole stored secrets and data.

stories.t: SEGA newsletter vendor data breach
stories.x: BleepingComputer reported that Japanese gaming giant SEGA disclosed that a data breach at its third-party newsletter provider, ARARA, exposed 2.2 million email addresses. Infosecurity Magazine reported that gaming company Sega warned customers to be vigilant for suspicious emails after hackers compromised Japanese email delivery provider Arara.

stories.t: QNAP warns users of Plex2Shell NAS vulnerabilities
stories.x: Security Affairs reported that Taiwanese vendor QNAP urged users to update Plex Media Server after reports of NAS compromises through the Plex2Shell vulnerability chain. SecurityWeek reported that threat actors are exploiting the four-flaw chain to hack the Plex Media Server application on QNAP NAS devices.

stories.t: Fireworks AI data breach
stories.x: The Record reported that Fireworks stated hackers stole data and billing info during October breaches affecting a limited number of customer accounts. The Hacker News reported that Fireworks AI disclosed that its investigation into a security incident uncovered further malicious activity affecting customer billing data and incomplete model weights.

stories.t: SonicWall SonicOS SSL-VPN Flaw Under Active Exploitation
stories.x: The Hacker News reported that CISA added a high-severity vulnerability impacting SonicWall SonicOS to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog amid reports of possible exploitation.

stories.t: Pro-Russian hackers leak European officials' personal data
stories.x: According to The Record, pro-Russian hackers published the personal information of Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani and other senior European officials on the dark web and offered rewards for personal information.

stories.t: Iris Plaza cloud breach exposes customer data
stories.x: The Register Security reported that a Japanese homeware giant pulled its online store after a cloud breach put 7.7 million records at risk. According to SecurityWeek, hackers compromised an external cloud service used by the shopping platform Iris Plaza and may have stolen personal information from it, potentially exposing data of 7.7 million customers.
